changelog:
**Major update: Skill focus shifted to automated flight fare searches.**

- Now performs automated searches for one-way flights from Manaus (MAO) to Belo Horizonte/Confins (CNF) for August 7–14, 2026.
- Runs twice daily (09:00 and 15:00, America/Manaus timezone) via cron and sends top 5 cheapest results to WhatsApp.
- Applies specific filters: max 1 connection, max 7h duration, arrival 8–16h, max price R$ 1.000, airline priority Azul > Latam.
- Legacy flight tracking/schedule scripts and docs were removed.
- Introduced a new PowerShell script (`scripts/search-flights.ps1`) for automated price checks.
summary: Busca automatizada de passagens aéreas MAO→CNF com cron 2x/dia e relatório no WhatsApp
